mode: synthetic renderer UI and request construction; all outside requests blocked; no real accounts, posts, votes, reports or deletions
checks: guest editor requires login and issues no creation requests
invalid options block writes; ordinary choice poll sends exact reviewed values
PK editor enforces two UTF16-limited viewpoints and optional colors
question editor opens related reads and normalizes title before its explicit create
verification keeps the reviewed request immutable and replays that exact request
switching account invalidates a pending verification without issuing a new-account replay
unconfirmed creation never auto-retries and needs an explicit latest-content check
local text drafts are account-scoped and require no publication
closing during image upload suppresses the later create rather than moving it to another account
native editor controls fit narrow windows and remain keyboard reachable in dark mode
